header.description: Lair statistics (FAM-11, stock): GetLairAveragesFromLocs, CountLairsByMaxRegen, CalculateAverageLairs, the Dictionary count helpers and the median/outlier helpers.
notes: GetLairInfo and GetDamageOutput are answered by the oracle from data.lairs and the case's lair_env (P3-16 ports the real ones); every GetDamageOutput call is recorded as an event.
Lair groups, monster numbers and the Summoned By text are real; the per-group numbers are invented.
